subject: prd/contract-gate
statement: a contract author avoiding the gate — vector: plans without invoking the precondition, or manually decomposes outside plan-new
fit_criterion: the precondition is wired into plan-new (FR-1); the continuous context (FR-9) catches contract defects independently of whether anyone plans; a plan whose inputs the gate would bounce is detectable by re-running the gate over the plan's pinned inputs. Residual: fully-manual planning outside the factory is visible to the human lane
